subject.title: [Bug]: Slack provider doesn't reliably reload after channels.slack.botToken rotation (cached singleAuthorization)

question: Should maintainers wait for a current-main/newest-release Sandpaw container or Control UI/config.patch reproduction before approving a fix path for this Slack token reload report?
rationale: Current source and release code already implement the normal restart path, and discussion evidence failed to reproduce direct-edit misses, so automation cannot safely choose the watcher, Control UI, or config RPC layer without maintainer proof criteria.

options.title: Require focused repro first
options.body: Keep this open and ask for the container/UI details already listed by the latest maintainer comment before queueing a code fix.

options.title: Proactively harden watcher
options.body: Treat container inotify loss as likely and design watcher health/polling hardening, accepting that the original failure path remains unproven.

options.title: Add explicit config.patch restart hook
options.body: Have Control UI or config.patch force a Slack restart after token saves, but first confirm this does not duplicate or fight the generic reload planner.

recommendation.title: Require focused repro first
recommendation.body: Keep this open and ask for the container/UI details already listed by the latest maintainer comment before queueing a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the issue, asked for the exact missing reproduction evidence, and has recent history in the gateway reload planner.
